Banu Cennetoğlu

right? On View

September 30, 2026–February 28, 2027

Banu Cennetoğlu: right?. Installation view: MassArt Art Museum (MAAM), Boston. Photo: Mel Taing '16.

Banu Cennetoğlu: right?. Detail of UDHR Article 26. Photo: Mel Taing '16.

Banu Cennetoğlu: right?. Installation view: MassArt Art Museum (MAAM), Boston. Photo: Mel Taing '16.

Banu Cennetoğlu presents right? (2022-ongoing), an evolving work that transforms articles from the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) into dense bouquets of gold Mylar letter balloons. For MAAM, the artist features UDHR Articles 25 and 26, which affirm the rights to an adequate standard of living and an education. As the balloons gradually deflate over the course of the exhibition, the work becomes a meditation on the labor required to sustain and protect rights that are treated as universal ideals but remain unevenly realized. Cennetoğlu asks viewers to consider not only whether these rights endure, but also whether societies continue to believe in and uphold them.

Location
Stephen D. Paine Gallery
Free and open to the public. Always.
Credits

Banu Cennetoğlu: right? was curated by Artistic Director Lisa Tung with Curatorial Affairs Manager Emily Edwards. MAAM’s unique and imaginative exhibitions, events, and programs would not happen without the support of the MAAM Programs! Funds initiated by gifts from Anonymous, The Jean Gaulin Foundation, The Andree LeBoeuf Foundation, and Elissa and Bill Warner. Thank you!
